spans.title: The Bear Pit
spans.blurb: A pleasant zoo outing turns in an instant when a restless toddler squirms above the sunken bear den, and only one quiet man does not step back.

spans.title: The Runaway Scow
spans.blurb: A rope snaps and a scow with one crouching passenger is swept into a black-walled canyon; a young man leaps aboard as the rapids ahead begin to roar.

spans.title: The Hill at Manassas
spans.blurb: Shells scream over a hilltop where a quiet general steadies his men, while up from the smoke below gallops a rider crying that all is lost.

spans.title: The Price of a Christian
spans.blurb: At a desert well, a traveling Englishman learns that the local chief means to kill him for being a Christian, and the haggling begins.

spans.title: Through the Sleeping Camp
spans.blurb: A traveler creeps into a strangers' camp at night, watching firelit faces and spinning prayer wheels, then leads his men straight through it in the dark.

spans.title: Sold at the Ford
spans.blurb: A crowd jeers at a ford as a slave dealer praises his wares: a lean girl with burning eyes, chained wrists, and a welt across her shoulders.

spans.title: Firelight and Fury
spans.blurb: A young storyteller holds a camp of drovers spellbound with a tale of the afterlife, until one burly listener demands to know how he can know it.

spans.title: Not Even a Little Pink
spans.blurb: American visitors stand in Red Square and find it, somehow, not red at all; a sour MVD man defends the symbolism of glorious Russia.

spans.title: Be You a Real Doctor?
spans.blurb: From a miserable makeshift boat, a silent brown-faced figure waits offshore for hours before daring a single question of the doctor at the rail.

spans.title: A Reckless Act of Zeal
spans.blurb: An English merchant in Portugal, appalled by the worship at a royal wedding, settles his affairs, closes his books, and returns to the cathedral with a New Testament.

spans.title: A Card of Lace
spans.blurb: A respectable lady buys black lace in a Bath shop; a quarter hour later she stands accused of theft, facing gaol and perhaps transportation.
